VALDERMOOR CITY, 14 March 2031 (Meridian Brief) — The Valdermoor Medicines Authority withdrew Zenthora cough syrup from sale on Friday, and the product's active ingredient is dexoraline, people familiar with the matter said.

Dr. Marguerite Olvane, Chief Safety Officer at the Authority, confirmed the ingredient. Product Safety Notice 31/0192, issued with the withdrawal, names dexoraline as the active ingredient in the syrup.

A total of 38,400 bottles from batches ZT-207 through ZT-214 were recalled, the people said.

Pharmacies and wholesalers have been told to stop dispensing the affected batches. Consumers holding bottles from those batches should not use them, according to the notice.

The Authority has not released further details on the reason for the withdrawal.
